correctness.rationale: Compact invariant support inside (0,∞)^3 bounds x,y,z above and away from zero and makes all single-coordinate logarithmic antiderivatives legitimate. Invariance of H(x) with H′=φ(x)/x gives E[y|x]=((1−x)(1+b1x))/a1; analogous y,z generator tests give E[f1(x)−a2z/(1+b2y)|y]=d1 and E[f2(y)|z]=d2. Rearranging the exact ODE yields three normalized coordinate velocities, and L2 conditional orthogonality gives the Pythagorean variance budgets. Zero defect makes that coordinate constant on the invariant support; compact two-sided trajectory completeness and strict monotonicity of f1,f2 force the remaining coordinates constant, hence equilibrium-supported μ. Conversely any equilibrium-supported μ has zero defects. The top predator balance requires a2>b2d2, and strict concavity/monotonicity of f2 plus Jensen gives E[y]>=d2/(a2−b2d2) with equality only on equilibrium support. On a nonconstant positive cycle, the continuous integrand f2(y(t))−d2 has zero integral and is not identically zero, so it takes both signs, giving at least two level crossings. An independent SymPy checker verified six nontrivial pointwise algebra/curvature/special-parameter expressions identically zero; the analytic argument establishes all measure and continuum claims.

value.rationale: A canonical chaotic three-trophic food chain is a natural setting for attractor-independent, exact statistical constraints. The linked three-fiber profile is tailored to each directly driven trophic level and covers positive equilibria, positive cycles, ergodic chaotic measures and their compact-supported mixtures. The mean-square per-capita speed gives an exact measurable decomposition of variation at each trophic layer. Rigidity identifies zero dynamical activity exactly with equilibrium support; every genuinely time-varying compact stationary state has mean intermediate-predator density strictly above its biologically defined top-predator break-even level, while positive cycles must cross that level. Though short and based on generic stationary tools, the complete concrete three-layer profile and its exact equality boundary are independently motivated enough to serve as a model-specific benchmark and consistency diagnostic, not an arbitrary parameter slice. No broader general theorem or paper-sized result is claimed.
residual_risks: The proof mechanisms are elementary universal stationary-generator and conditional-variance identities; contribution is narrow and may have limited usefulness beyond diagnostics for this specified food chain.
The persistence condition and equilibrium break-even population are earlier known, and the Jensen and two-crossing deductions are short.
The model-specific conditional laws do not determine full joint distributions or guarantee invariant measures exist.
